title: Drummer phrasing and the Caceres brothers
summary: Manno says a drummer should play rhythmic phrases, criticizes progressive drummers, and recalls the Caceres brothers from San Antonio.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
